knowledge:
- key_parameters: data=A mutation dataset containing columns Chromosome, Position, Sample, Gene (optional), Group (for compare_groups), and clinical parameters (for compare_features) ;; regions=A genomic regions dataset containing columns Chromosome, Lowerbound, Upperbound, Gene (optional), and Count (optional) ;; pvalue/pval=Significance threshold for Kolmogorov-Smirnov tests ;; threshold=Empirical distribution threshold for hotspot selection or group comparison ;; include_genes=Logical indicating whether to include gene names in the output ;; rank=Logical indicating whether to rank regions in find_hotspots ;; name1/name2=Group names for comparison in compare_groups ;; feature=Vector of clinical features to analyze in compare_features
- alternatives: seq.hotSPOT is used prior to compSPOT to identify highly mutated genomic regions from SNV datasets ;; RTCGA.mutations and RTCGA.clinical can be used to pull mutation and clinical datasets from the TCGA database as alternative input sources
- when_to_use: Use when you have SNV/mutation datasets and genomic regions and want to identify statistically significant mutation hotspots, compare hotspot mutation burden between distinct clinical groups, or explore how mutation burden correlates with clinical or personal risk factors (e.g., age, gender, smoking history)
- pitfalls: Input mutation data must have specific column names ("Chromosome", "Position", "Sample", "Gene", "Group", and clinical parameters) ;; Input regions data must have specific column names ("Chromosome", "Lowerbound", "Upperbound", "Gene", "Count") ;; compare_groups requires a "Group" column in the mutation dataset ;; compare_features requires the specified features to be present as columns in the mutation dataset

workflows.name: mutation_hotspot_analysis
workflows.intent: Identify significant mutation hotspots from genomic regions, compare hotspot burden between patient groups, and correlate mutation burden with clinical risk factors.
input: mutation_data.csv (mutation dataset containing Chromosome, Position, Sample, Gene, Group, and clinical parameters)
regions_data.csv (genomic regions dataset containing Chromosome, Lowerbound, Upperbound, Gene, Count)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the mutation and genomic region datasets ;; 2. Identify significant mutation hotspots using find_hotspots ;; 3. Filter the identified hotspots for downstream analysis ;; 4. Compare mutation hotspot burden between defined groups using compare_groups ;; 5. Perform exploratory data analysis of mutation hotspot burden against clinical features using compare_features
workflows.code:
library(compSPOT)
data("compSPOT_example_mutations")
data("compSPOT_example_regions")
significant_spots <- find_hotspots(data = compSPOT_example_mutations, 
                                   regions = compSPOT_example_regions, 
                                   pvalue = 0.05, threshold = 0.2, 
                                   include_genes = TRUE, 
                                   rank = TRUE)
head(significant_spots[[1]])
hotspots <- subset(significant_spots[[1]], type == "Hotspot")

group_comp <- compare_groups(data = compSPOT_example_mutations, 
                             regions = hotspots, pval = 0.05, 
                             threshold = 0.2, 
                             name1 = "High-Risk", 
                             name2 = "Low-Risk", 
                             include_genes = TRUE)
group_comp[[1]]
features <- c("AGE", "SEX", "SMOKING_HISTORY", "TUMOR_VOLUME", "KI_67")
feature_example <- compare_features(data = compSPOT_example_mutations, 
                                    regions = compSPOT_example_regions, 
                                    feature = features)
